# Life Extension Corporation

> Life Extension Corporation is a fictional, non-commercial fan-made narrative experience inspired by a film. It is not a real medical, legal, or financial service.

## What this site contains

Life Extension explores a fictional cryonic suspension protocol, long-term stewardship, and optional continuity concepts such as Lucid Dream, Memory Splice, Dream Architecture, and Life Archive.

The site includes bilingual editorial pages in English and Italian, a fictional FAQ, and a browser-only proposal wizard. The proposal wizard does not transmit entered information and generates its dossier locally on the device.

## Important disclosure

All preservation, restoration, and continuity claims on this site are fictional narrative material. Do not interpret them as medical advice, a treatment offer, or a promise of future restoration.
